guard: a once Jcode seat's launched tree is proved gone only by the evidence its host recorded under the seat's uid: never while the recorded host lives, every launch the uid recorded, a receipt that replays the proof, and live evidence never discarded; a launched process whose environment cannot be read is still tied to the launch by a parent already found or by a group a carrier leads, a signal reaches a group only when a carrier leads it and never a pid with another start token, and a found process whose entry cannot be read stops the proof, and a process is alive by one read of its entry, so a failed re-read never reads as an exit, and a live process whose entry cannot be read stops the proof whether or not the launch scan found it
why: R1 proves a seat retired while its recorded host still runs, and signals that host's tree. R2
keeps only the latest launch, so a bridge relaunch's first tree is never stopped. R3 writes no
receipt, so a manager that crashes after the proof and before its clear can never get it back.
R4 discards live evidence. R5 never tells the host it is a once seat, so it records nothing.
R6 drops the group link, so a hidden process left in the server's group outlives the proof. R7 drops the
parent link, so a hidden child that moved to its own group outlives it. R8 ties a process only to a parent
that carries the identity, so a hidden child's own child outlives the proof. R9 signals every target's
group, so a process outside the launch that joined a group a descendant leads is killed. R10 signals a pid
without its start token, so a process that took a target's pid is killed. R11 reads a found process's unreadable entry
as a process gone, so the rest of the launch is signalled before the scan of every other process stops
the proof. R12 reads a process's
entry twice and takes a failed second read as an exit, so a launched process whose re-read fails is
dropped from the proof while it still runs. R13 lets
that scan pass over a live process whose entry it cannot read, so a launched process whose entry never
reads is left out of the proof while it runs.

mutations.name: R1 a live recorded host no longer refuses the proof
mutations.find:
if (alive(record.host.pid))
    throw new Error(`jcode connector: once seat ${uid}'s recorded host PID ${record.host.pid} is alive — its processes cannot be proved gone`);
mutations.expectRed: a live recorded host refuses the proof

mutations.name: R2 the evidence keeps only the latest launch
R3 the proof writes no receipt
mutations.expectRed: the proof is kept as a receipt

mutations.name: R4 live evidence is discarded
mutations.find: if (!("retired" in record)) throw new Error(`jcode connector: once seat ${uid}'s evidence is not a retirement receipt — refusing to discard it`);

mutations.name: R5 a once launch does not tell the host
mutations.expectRed: a once launch tells the host it is a once seat

mutations.name: R6 a process left in the server's group is not tied to the launch
mutations.expectRed: ...after the process left in the server's group, which ignored SIGTERM, is gone

mutations.name: R7 a child is not tied to the launch by its proved parent
mutations.expectRed: ...and the child tied only by its parent is gone

mutations.name: R8 a process is tied by its parent only when that parent carries the identity
mutations.expectRed: ...after the grandchild, tied only through its hidden parent, is gone

mutations.name: R9 every target's group is signalled
mutations.expectRed: a process outside the launch that joined the hidden child's group is not signalled

mutations.name: R10 a signal skips the start token
mutations.expectRed: a launched process that shows another start token after SIGTERM is not sent SIGKILL

mutations.name: R11 a found process whose entry cannot be read counts as gone
mutations.find: if (alive(p.pid)) throw new Error(`jcode connector: PID ${p.pid} was found in the once launch, and its process table entry can no longer be read to rule it out`);
mutations.expectRed: a launched process: a sibling launched with it is still running when the proof stops

mutations.name: R12 a failed re-read of a process entry counts as an exit
mutations.expectRed: a launched process whose entry fails a re-read (synthetic EMFILE) is still stopped before the proof

mutations.name: R13 the scan passes over a live process whose entry cannot be read
mutations.find: if (alive(pid)) throw new Error(`jcode connector: cannot read PID ${pid}'s process table entry to rule it out of a once launch`);
mutations.expectRed: a launched process whose process table entry cannot be read at all stops the proof
